notes: Ludum Dare 49 SIRTET (Unstable theme, compo). Unity C# complete project (Assets+ProjectSettings+Packages). Apache-2.0. Bundled fonts: LiberationSans and Press Start 2P (both SIL OFL 1.1; Red Hat/Google and The Press Start 2P Project Authors) with bundled license text. Official Unity packages only (2D animation/pixel-perfect/sprite/spriteshape, Burst, Cinemachine, Input System, URP, Timeline, TextMeshPro). WebGL template Better2020 (greggman/better-unity-webgl-template, CC0-1.0). No LFS, no DOTween DLL, no EmojiOne, no Asset Store packages. ~15M src snapshot.
